candidates.change_summary: Replace the require guard to allow any caller (remove owner restriction), changing which calls succeed and thereby altering post-call observable behavior.
Change the require to check the receiver equals owner so only transfers to owner are allowed, altering which transfers succeed and observable state.
Invert the require condition so owner is blocked and non-owner callers are allowed, changing which calls succeed and observable behavior.
Insert a zero-amount early return preventing any transfer, changing post-call state by ensuring no funds are sent.
Replace the transfer target with owner so funds always go to owner regardless of receiver argument, altering observed transfers.
